title: Homotopy invariance of enriched coends with one projectively cofibrant variable
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, weak homotopy equivalences and universes of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and enriched projective diagram model structures of [lem-coef-simplicial-projective-model-calculus]. Let $A$ be a small simplicial category. A left module is an enriched functor $H:A\to\mathsf{sSet}$ and a right module is an enriched functor $V:A^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathsf{sSet}$. Define $V\otimes_A H$ to be the coequalizer of the action maps
$$\coprod_{a,b}V(b)\times A(a,b)\times H(a)\rightrightarrows\coprod_a V(a)\times H(a).$$
For $B=A$ or $A^{\mathrm{op}}$, an enriched diagram $B\to\mathsf{sSet}$ is projectively cofibrant if and only if its initial map is a retract of a transfinite composite, continuous at limit stages, of pushouts of coproducts of $B(b,-)\times\partial\Delta^k\to B(b,-)\times\Delta^k$, with $k\geq0$. If $H$ is projectively cofibrant, every objectwise weak homotopy equivalence $V\to V'$ induces a weak homotopy equivalence $V\otimes_AH\to V'\otimes_AH$. If $V$ is projectively cofibrant, every objectwise weak homotopy equivalence $H\to H'$ induces a weak homotopy equivalence $V\otimes_AH\to V\otimes_AH'$. No cofibrancy or fibrancy hypothesis on the varying modules, and no local Kan hypothesis on $A$, is required.
